paragraphs: A modern URL shortener and link-in-bio platform built for businesses, creators, and brands.

Shortn is a comprehensive link management solution that goes beyond simple URL shortening. It provides powerful analytics, customizable QR codes, and beautiful link-in-bio pages—all in one platform. Currently serving Vida Económica, Portugal's leading economic magazine, Shortn has been trusted to deliver over 2.4 million clicks with enterprise-grade reliability.
Shortn helps you create, manage, and track every link you share. Whether you're running marketing campaigns, managing social media, or building your personal brand, Shortn gives you the tools to:
features: Shorten URLs with custom, branded links
Track engagement with real-time analytics and insights
Generate QR codes with full customization options
Build link-in-bio pages that showcase all your important links in one place
Organize campaigns and measure performance across channels
